comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html:
Honestly, the only thing that really makes that gun look different is the longer barrel and the magazine foregrip. If the foregrip isn’t going to be a thing, probably better to just make it a server mod and not an entirely new weapon. You can just add the weapFireType field in the item’s json file and it can fire full auto if you really wanted to.

The sounds might be a bit weird firing in full auto because the sounds were designed for a semi-auto weapon. The game uses different audio methods for full auto firing, but you can give it a shot and let me know how ridiculous the gun is. lol
